title: The musicians' whistle at the door and on parade
summary: Why musicians whistled at houses and on parade.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Ann Buell, well, tell me this, ma. She's been kind of sick with that stroke and all that. Did you ever listen to jazz bands doing all this? Like a father, when they were, guys would come out of my house when I was a kid, they would go. You know, instead of knocking on the door, they always did that. And a lot of people do that now.
You know, she can send it. You know that thing they had, that whistle? Oh, yeah. And you always know those are musicians. Did you ever find anything about her?
I had the trumpet players do it on parade, but I don't know where.
But why do you think they do it on parade?
I would guess to get everybody ready to play the piece. Yeah.
